name: AI and agents
lead: Agents held to hard limits, and tools to check them.
intro: Eight repos where an AI agent or model is held to a hard limit: writes and destructive actions wait for a person, answers need evidence, lab instruments stay inside signed-off limits, and model output must match a schema. Two of them check agents themselves, by replaying their tool calls and by auditing MCP servers.

repos.tag: Incident triage with a human approval gate
SQL for agents; every write waits for a person
facts: A human runs sqlguard approve <token> out of band. Each approval is single-use and bound to the exact statement. SQLite only.

repos.tag: Lab instruments for agents, behind interlocks
facts: MCP Python SDK, SCPI over TCP, Hypothesis

repos.tag: Replays an agent's tool calls on a new model
facts: Python standard library only (optional Anthropic and MCP SDKs), pytest, Hypothesis
pytest -q (with the optional Anthropic and MCP SDKs installed, as in CI)

repos.tag: Audits MCP servers in a traced sandbox
facts: Official MCP Python SDK, Docker, strace
make images && pytest -q (4 of them need the Docker sandbox images, as in CI's sandbox job)

repos.tag: Cited answers, or a refusal
Schema-checked routing across LLM providers
facts: Node.js, Anthropic, OpenAI, zero runtime deps

repos.tag: Network and SSH tools, denied until opted in
facts: 4 of its 18 tools: shell, SSH connect and execute, and process kill.

name: Data and storage
lead: Storage, replication and data contracts, checked under faults.
intro: Seven repos about keeping data correct: a graph database written from scratch, Raft and a CRDT attacked by fault simulators and fuzzers, a crash-consistency tester for storage code, PostgreSQL migrations tried on a copy under live traffic, contracts for JSON event streams, and lossless time-series compression.

repos.tag: Storage engine, transactions and its own query language
facts: pnpm test (468 engine and server tests plus 218 web app tests)

repos.tag: Local-first notes on a fuzzed CRDT
facts: npm test and npm run e2e (37 unit tests plus 2 end-to-end tests in two browsers)

repos.tag: Raft under a deterministic fault simulator
facts: Go standard library only, deterministic simulation, linearizability checking

repos.tag: Every state a power cut can leave on disk
facts: Go standard library only, strace, SQLite in a Docker dev image

repos.tag: What a PostgreSQL migration will lock
facts: go test -race -count=1 -json ./... (28 tests plus 12 subtests, against a live PostgreSQL as in CI)

repos.tag: Breaking-change checks for JSON events
facts: Go standard library only, GitHub Actions

repos.tag: Time-series compression, best codec per block
facts: Rust standard library only, no dependencies, GitHub Actions
cargo test --locked (4 unit, 5 cli, 4 corrupt, 7 roundtrip, 1 doc test; the 1M-series soak test is ignored by default)

name: Reliability in production
lead: Latency, limits, alerts and flaky tests, measured instead of assumed.
intro: Seven repos that measure how software behaves in production instead of assuming it: request time budgets across services, rate limiters under skewed clocks and restarts, trace diffs that catch N+1 queries, alert rules replayed against past incidents, regression tests for noisy systems, flaky tests diagnosed by cause, and a real-time dashboard measured in the browser.

repos.tag: Request time budgets across HTTP services
facts: Java 21 standard library only (JDK HttpClient and HttpServer), JUnit 5, Maven
./mvnw -B verify (39 test methods plus 10 parameterised cases)

repos.tag: Rate limiters under clock skew and restarts
facts: Go standard library only, Redis and Lua
go test -count=1 -json ./... (2 of them need a real Redis, as in CI)

repos.tag: Before-and-after OpenTelemetry trace diffs
facts: Go, OTLP protobuf types; OpenTelemetry Collector and Postgres demo in Docker
go test -race -count=1 -json ./... and make demo-test (21 tests plus 12 subtests, and 4 demo tests, one of which needs Postgres as in CI's demo job)

repos.tag: Alert rules replayed against past incidents
facts: Python standard library only, Hypothesis, Prometheus range-query import

repos.tag: Regression tests for noisy systems
Why each flaky test flakes
facts: pytest -m "not slow" and pytest -m slow (42 fast tests plus 5 slow ones that run whole hunts, as CI splits them)

repos.tag: A real-time dashboard, measured in the browser
facts: Angular 22 zoneless with signals, no UI or chart library, Playwright, axe-core
npm test and npx playwright test (32 unit tests plus 28 Playwright tests)

name: Change gates and tooling
lead: Checks that stop a risky change before it merges.
intro: Four repos that check a change before it lands or ships: what an npm upgrade can newly do, what a Kubernetes admission policy would have blocked, and who gains or loses access when a permission schema changes. runon, the fourth, runs shell programs across a group of servers over SSH.

repos.tag: What an npm upgrade can newly do
Admission policies replayed on the audit log
facts: Go, Kubernetes apiserver libraries v0.34.1, kind, GitHub Actions

repos.tag: Who gains or loses access in a schema change
facts: Go standard library only, SpiceDB in Docker, GitHub Actions
go test -count=1 -json ./... (2 of them need a live SpiceDB, as in CI)

repos.tag: Shell programs across servers over SSH
facts: SSH, PyPI, stdlib only on Python 3.11+ (no runtime dependencies)
pytest (3 of them need zsh or csh installed, as in CI)

name: Drones and field work
lead: Flight safety, firmware and geology, tested in simulators and on emulators.
intro: Six repos for aircraft, firmware and the ground: a ROS 2 guard that forwards only setpoints it can prove safe, terrain clearance proofs for drone missions, CI checks for autopilot parameters, A/B firmware updates that survive power cuts, and a ground model and field notebook for borehole logs.

repos.tag: Forwards only setpoints proven inside the envelope
facts: C++17, ROS 2 Jazzy, GoogleTest, PX4 SITL
The core and CLI build anywhere with CMake. The ROS 2 node and the PX4 SITL flights run in CI.
make test (87 GoogleTest cases plus 9 CLI tests; the 10 ROS 2 node tests run in CI and are not counted here)

repos.tag: Proves a mission clears the terrain
facts: Python standard library only, Hypothesis, PX4 SITL in Docker
pytest -q (38 test functions, 203 of the items parametrised)

repos.tag: CI check for PX4 and ArduPilot parameters
facts: Python standard library only, composite GitHub Action, PX4 SITL in Docker
pytest -q (1 of them needs ArduCopter 4.6.3's parameter metadata from make ap-meta, as in CI)

repos.tag: A/B firmware updates that survive power cuts
facts: no_std Rust with sha2 and ed25519-dalek, QEMU Cortex-M3
cargo test --locked (the depth-2 search, run by make deep, is ignored by default)

repos.tag: Borehole logs to a ground model with intervals
facts: No dependencies, ordinary kriging, leave-one-out calibration

repos.tag: Offline Android notebook for boreholes
facts: Kotlin 2.0, Jetpack Compose, CRDTs with no merge library, Android emulator in CI
./gradlew test and connectedDebugAndroidTest (33 JVM tests, 3 app unit tests and 3 Compose UI tests on an emulator)
